title: oreogrammitis setulifera

This plant is traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
